question: Which of the following is NOT a revenue receipt by the government?

options.text: Cash grants-in-aid from foreign countries and international organisations
Fees and other receipts for services rendered by the government
Dividends and profits on investments made by the government

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Sale of government assets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Government revenue is the money that the government receives through taxes and non-tax sources to undertake government expenditures. 
 
• It is classified into revenue receipts and capital receipts. 
 
• Examples of revenue receipts are 
 
 
• Cash grants-in-aid from foreign countries and international organizations.
 
• Fees and other receipts for services rendered by the government.
 
• Dividends and profits on investments made by the government.
 
 
 
• ​The sale of government assets is part of capital receipts.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Features of revenue receipts 

 
• The revenue receipts are recurring in nature.
 
• It does not create any liability for the government.
 
• It should not lead to a fall in the assets of the government.
 
• The revenue receipts are non-redeemable 
 
• It can be further classified into tax revenue and non-tax revenue.
